name: flightterm
description: Flight tracking terminal — React + Express. v5.2.1 fixes the three silent data pipelines (sightings, anomalies, mil flag) that made the v5.2.0 feed a route-deviation-only ranker. Multi-signal corroboration now actually happens: orbit, mil, squawk, and callsign signals overlap on real events.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend,swim --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:swim"
